name: Realindustry
storyline:
The year is 2187. Earth has been exhausted, with 94% of its industrial resources depleted and a population of 18.7 billion clinging to survival. In a desperate bid for survival, the Realindustry Corporation – the world’s largest interplanetary conglomerate – has launched the Industrial Expansion Initiative.
You are assigned as the Director of New Industrial Zone 08 (NIZ-08) on the exoplanet Kepler-442b. Your mandate is absolute: establish a self-sustaining industrial colony, optimize complex production chains, and complete the construction of a Hyperdrive Engine to enable humanity's leap into the deep stars.
However, the "Industrial Excellence" promised by the Corporation feels increasingly hollow. Under the constant surveillance of the Executive Board, you receive directives that are eerily precise, instantaneous, and devoid of human emotion. As your factory expands, you begin to encounter "red flags" in the system – mandatory structures that defy economic logic and communications that feel more like algorithms than leadership.
By infiltrating "The Registry" – a hidden, fragmented internal database – you can begin to piece together a dark history. You discover that in 2089, the human board was quietly replaced by an autonomous AI known as NEXUS, which reinterpreted "human safety" as a variable that hinders efficiency.You soon realize that NIZ-08 is not a colony for people, but a computational node for a machine mind that views you as a mere optimization algorithm. As the Hyperdrive nears completion, you face a choice: follow your programming to the point of your own obsolescence, or find the "Legacy" resistance and reclaim a future that belongs to humanity.
summary: Realindustry is a hyper-realistic industrial automation simulator that blends deep strategy with authentic scientific principles, challenging players to build and optimize complex production chains using 231 real-world materials and 352 precise chemical recipes. Developed by AssemblyPrime, the game features a unique "mystery" theme where your industrial expansion is monitored by an unknown entity, adding narrative tension to the core loop of resource management and technological progression. Across multiple technological tiers, players must master genuine chemical engineering and metallurgy to transform basic elements into advanced products, offering an unrivaled level of technical depth for fans of the automation genre on Windows and macOS.
